name: "Monster" Burgers with Mozzarella, Lettuce, Tomato & Pickle

instructions.primary_message: Place beef and spices in a medium bowl; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the beef mixture into 6 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 lb lean ground beef
2 tsp Italian seasoning
1 tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet (or 2 medium skillets) over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties, and cook an additional 2-3 minutes, until cooked through.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the lettuce. Separate into leaves and place on a clean plate.
Wash, dry, and thinly slice tomatoes. Add to the plate with the lettuce.
Stack cheese slices one on top of the other. Using a knife, cut a "v" pattern along one edge of the cheese stack to create pointed "teeth." Separate the slices and add to the plate.
Count out 12 toothpicks. Skewer 1 olive onto the end of each toothpick to create 12 "eyes." Set aside.

When the burgers are done, remove to another clean plate. Top each with a pickle slice (letting it hang over the side of the burger to create a "tongue") and a cheese slice (arranging it so the "teeth" hang over the pickle slightly). Set aside to allow the cheese to soften, 1 minute.

To assemble the burgers, spread the bottom half of each bun with mayo. Top with lettuce, tomato, and a patty, then drizzle with ketchup. Close with the top half of each bun and skewer each burger with 2 "eyes".
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
⅓ cup ketchup

instructions.primary_message: To serve, arrange burgers on a platter. Enjoy!
